senses.gloss: m. (διοικήτης, dioecetes) overseer of the treasury, treasurer.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> (prov.) unfortunate the district where the physician has the gout, <he>ודאיקוטטא בחד עינא</he> ed. (Mus. <he>ודייקטסא</he>, corr. acc.) and the treasurer only one eye (is unable to examine the coins).
